snippet.title: Hozy: Hideaways DLC - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the Free DLC Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5145980/Hozy_Hideaways 

Hozy: Hideaways, a free DLC for all Hozy players, invites you to explore three new levels - each with its own unique atmosphere and personality. Meet the characters who call these spaces home, discover the little details that make each place unique, and take your time turning them into something special.

When you’re ready to keep creating, take the new furniture and décor with you into Sandbox Mode. Mix, match, rearrange, and experiment with fresh items to make your very own space feel just right!
